content.text:
Excellent! All 53 tests pass. I've added two new line-management functions to `src/invoices.js`:

**`addLine(invoice, { sku, qty })`** — Adds a line to a draft invoice or increases qty if the SKU already exists. Validates qty and SKU the same way `createInvoice` does. Returns `fail(NOT_DRAFT)` if the invoice isn't in 'draft' status.

**`removeLine(invoice, sku)`** — Removes a line from a draft invoice. Returns:
- `fail(NOT_DRAFT)` if invoice status isn't 'draft'
- `fail(LINE_NOT_FOUND)` if the SKU isn't on the invoice
- `fail(NO_LINES)` if it's the last line (invoices must have at least one)

Both functions never mutate the input invoice and return new objects with updated lines.

Added error codes: `LINE_NOT_FOUND` and `NOT_DRAFT`.

Added 13 comprehensive tests covering adding new/existing lines, removing lines (including middle and last), chaining operations, immutability, and all error cases. ✅
